full_prompt_en: A square natural-history illustration gives an extreme close view of a large owl, its patterned head and upper breast set against a pale meadow and layered gray clouds. The bird fills the left and central areas, with the top of one dark ear tuft and much of its body cut by the image edges. Its round amber eye sits just left of center, sharply ringed in black and edged with pale feathering, so the pupil becomes the clearest point in the scene. A strong dark brow sweeps above the eye and leads toward the high, hooked black beak on the right. Fine cream, buff, umber, and charcoal marks articulate the feathers in overlapping bands: close barring across the crown, shorter hairlike strokes around the facial disk, and bold dark stripes down the visible breast. The separate textures follow the shape of each part rather than appearing as a uniform surface pattern. At the upper right, clouds build in scalloped gray layers, their edges softly lit against a darker sky. Below them a pale strip opens over thin upright meadow stems and seed heads, which remain small and delicate beside the owl. A few leaves and branches crowd the upper edge behind the bird, tying the foreground close-up to the surrounding habitat. Gentle light from the right brightens the cream feathers and the pale space behind the beak, while the left side of the bird and the cloud recesses hold cool gray shadow. The image has a finely engraved or colored-pencil-like density, with many short directional strokes and clear contour changes but no shiny finish. The overall composition contrasts monumental, closely observed feather detail with a compressed, quieter landscape in a restrained range of warm browns and cold grays.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形自然史插画以极近距离呈现一只大猫头鹰，带纹样的头和上胸映在浅色草地与层叠灰云之前。鸟体占据左侧及中央，头顶一束深色耳羽和身体的大部分被画边截断。琥珀色圆眼位于中央稍左，黑色眼圈鲜明，外缘有浅色羽毛，因此瞳孔成为画面最清楚的焦点。强烈的深色眉羽扫过眼上，向右引到高而弯的黑色喙。细密的奶油色、黄褐色、深褐色与炭色痕迹，把羽毛刻成层叠的带状区域：头顶有紧密横纹，面盘周围是较短的发丝状笔画，可见胸部则向下排列粗重深条纹。不同肌理顺着各部位形状生长，并非均匀铺开的表面图案。右上方云层堆成扇贝状灰色层次，边缘在深色天空前得到柔和照亮。云下，一条浅色空隙越过细直的草茎和草籽，它们在猫头鹰旁显得小而纤细。几片叶和枝从鸟后挤到上画边，将前景近景与周围栖息地联系起来。温和的光从右侧照亮奶油色羽毛与喙后的浅色空间，鸟体左侧和云间凹处则保持冷灰阴影。图像有精细版画或彩色铅笔般的密度，由大量短而顺形的笔画及清晰轮廓变化组成，没有光亮的表面。整体构图把宏大的、近距离观察的羽毛细节，与被压缩而更安静的风景对比，色彩克制在暖棕与冷灰之间。
style_prompt_en: The natural-history illustration combines densely observed, directional linework with subdued washes of earthy color. Short hatching and small interlocking marks build rough, layered surfaces; the stroke direction changes with each contour, keeping the intricate texture dimensional. Cream and amber highlights sit within buff, umber, charcoal, and cool gray, creating one compact warm focal area against broader pale and shadowed regions. Crisp edges and strong dark accents hold the near forms, while thin distant marks and softly graded clouds recede. Side light reveals the raised texture and lets recesses stay cool without a theatrical glare. The composition favors a large cropped foreground form and a much quieter background, giving close detail a sense of scale and natural stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 自然史插画把密集观察所得的顺形线条与低调土色薄层结合。短排线和细小交错痕迹建立粗糙、层叠的表面；笔画方向随轮廓变化，使复杂肌理仍有体积。奶油色和琥珀色高光位于黄褐、深褐、炭色与冷灰之间，在更宽阔的浅色和阴影区域前形成紧凑暖色焦点。清晰边缘与强深色强调固定近处形体，远处细线和柔和渐层则向后退去。侧光揭示凸起肌理，让凹处保持冷色而没有戏剧化炫光。构图偏重大幅裁切的前景形体和安静得多的背景，使近处细节带有尺度感与自然的静止感。
theme_en: A close view of a large owl against a pale meadow and layered gray clouds
theme_zh: 一只大猫头鹰的近景，背后是浅色草地与层叠灰云
name: Charles Tunnicliffe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
